Name: Broadsword of the Steady Hand
Description: This well-balanced high steel (+5) broadsword has a grip wrapped in grey leather and a pommel of polished granite. The wielder gains a +15 bonus to Parry skill and finds their hands steady even in slippery or unstable conditions. The blade hums faintly when drawn, a sign of its protective enchantment.
Recipe: Work Mundane Metal I (7), Weapon I (5), Constant V (9). Days: 18. Standard cost: 412 sp. Level 9 item.
